an3.47:1.1: “Monks, these three are fabricated characteristics of what is fabricated.
an3.47:1.3: Arising is discernable, passing away is discernable, alteration [literally: otherness] while staying is discernable (alteration [literally: otherness] of what stays is discernable).
an3.47:1.4: “These are three fabricated characteristics of what is fabricated.
an3.47:2.1: “Now these three are unfabricated characteristics of what is unfabricated.
an3.47:2.3: No arising is discernable, no passing away is discernable, no alteration while staying is discernable (no alteration of what stays is discernable).
an3.47:2.4: “These are three unfabricated characteristics of what is unfabricated.”
